landing.whatEn: An agent skill in chuspeeism’s repo. On X the author’s display name is 大师的AI小灶, account @dashiAIxz. At 03:47 UTC on 26 Sept 2026 he posted a recommendation that points at https://github.com/chuspeeism/dashi-ppt-skill . fxtwitter shows that post quotes his other post from 03:43 UTC the same day, whose text is that he made a promo video for his own product. That promo’s attachment metadata is 42.583 seconds at 1920×1080. The promo post is linked here. No frame was taken from it, and this page does not say what the video was made with. The README’s path is: hand a document to an agent, get a web deck with an edit console in the browser on every page, change what you don’t like in the browser, then export an editable PPTX in one click, or an offline HTML bundle or a PDF. rows.aspect: 对照让模型直接写 HTML 幻灯片
rows.aspectEn: Beside asking a model for raw HTML slides
rows.left: 产物是一套按主题分好的网页 PPT。README 写每一页由版式加文案字段构成，页面上有滑杆、开关和下拉，用来换布局、调模块数量、换配色、换这一页的重点。文字点击就能改。
rows.leftEn: The output is a web deck split by theme. The README says every page is a layout plus copy fields, with sliders, toggles, and dropdowns to switch layout, change how many modules show, change the palette, and shift that page’s emphasis. Text is edited by clicking it.
rows.right: 直接让模型写一份 HTML 幻灯片，版式通常是这一次对话里现编的。没有 README 里按 12 套主题分开的版式库，也没有每一页附带的那块控制台。要改结构，多半是再改提示词，或去改生成出来的标记。
rows.rightEn: Asking a model to write an HTML slide file usually means the layout is invented in that conversation. There is no theme library split into the 12 themes the README describes, and no console attached to each page. Changing the structure usually means another prompt, or editing the markup that came back.

rows.aspect: 对照 Gamma 这一类在线做片
rows.aspectEn: Beside a Gamma-style hosted deck service
rows.left: README 的 FAQ 写：文档和 PPT 内容不上传，生成、编辑、导出都在本机，成品可以离线打开。会联网的是首次用 npm 装依赖，以及做完后只拉取最新版本号的检查。本地预览默认同一个局域网里可以看，导出接口只对本机开放。
rows.leftEn: The README FAQ says documents and deck content are not uploaded; generation, editing, and export stay on the machine, and the finished file opens offline. The network is used to npm-install dependencies the first time, and for a version check after a task that only fetches the latest version number. The local preview is reachable on the same LAN; export endpoints are local-only.
rows.right: Gamma 这一类网站是把稿子交到对方的产品里编辑，再从对方那里导出。对照点在于：这份 skill 的 README 把编辑和导出写在本机。本站没有注册 Gamma，也没有拿它的导出文件和这里的 PPTX 逐页对比。
rows.rightEn: A Gamma-style service is where you edit the draft inside their product and export from there. The comparison is that this skill’s README puts editing and export on your machine. This site did not sign up for Gamma, and did not compare its export file with this PPTX page by page.

rows.aspect: 对照用 python-pptx 直接写文件
rows.aspectEn: Beside writing the file with python-pptx
rows.left: PPTX 从已经生成的网页版导出。README 写逐节点还原，文字保持可编辑；也可以让 Agent 跳过网页中间态，直接说要 PPT 文件。命令行是在项目目录里跑 export:pptx。导出 PPTX 和 PDF 需要本机的 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge。
rows.leftEn: The PPTX is exported from the web deck that was already generated. The README says nodes are reconstructed and text stays editable. You can also tell the agent to skip the web step and produce a PPT file directly. The command line runs export:pptx inside the project directory. PPTX and PDF export need local Chrome, Chromium, or Edge.
rows.right: python-pptx 是用 Python 把幻灯片写进 PPTX 的库。对照点在于：那条路的操作界面是代码和生成出来的文件，不是 README 里每一页一块控制台的网页。本站没有用 python-pptx 把同一份文档做一遍来比文件。
rows.rightEn: python-pptx is a Python library that writes slides into a PPTX. The comparison is that its interface is code plus the file it writes, not the per-page browser console the README describes. This site did not rebuild the same document with python-pptx to compare files.

steps.title: 按 README 安装
steps.titleEn: Install the way the README says
steps.body: 环境是 Node.js 20+ 和 npm。安装和更新是同一条命令：npx dashi-ppt-skill@latest。国内网络，中文 README 写的是 npx --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com dashi-ppt-skill@latest。英文 README 写它会探测常见的 skills 目录，也可以用 --dir 指到一个目录，例子是 --dir ~/.claude/skills。重跑就是原地更新，已经装上的依赖会留着。也可以把这句安装命令交给 Agent。2026-09-26 查 registry.npmjs.org，包 dashi-ppt-skill 的 latest 是 0.4.5，license 为 AGPL-3.0-only，time.modified 为 2026-08-01。同一天 gh api 读到默认分支 pushed_at 为 2026-09-12T14:13:08Z。本站没有把这个 npm 版本和 GitHub 上的某一次提交对上。
steps.bodyEn: You need Node.js 20+ and npm. Install and update are the same command: npx dashi-ppt-skill@latest. For networks in China, the Chinese README gives npx --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com dashi-ppt-skill@latest. The English README says it detects common skills directories, and --dir points at one directory, with the example --dir ~/.claude/skills. Running it again updates in place and keeps dependencies that are already installed. You can also hand that install line to an agent. On 26 Sept 2026, registry.npmjs.org listed dashi-ppt-skill latest as 0.4.5, license AGPL-3.0-only, time.modified 2026-08-01. The same day the gh api read pushed_at on the default branch as 2026-09-12T14:13:08Z. This site did not match that npm version to a specific GitHub commit.

steps.title: 先选一套主题，再让它组稿
steps.titleEn: Pick a theme, then let it draft the deck
steps.body: README 的使用顺序是：先说主题、受众、页数和想突出的结论。Skill 会拿出 12 套风格预览让你选，并确认要不要图片或视频；之后可以让 Agent 把整套风格换掉。然后它把需求整理成结构化内容，并配上对应的页面方案。README 写每套主题有自己的页面结构和视觉语言，页面角色有 20 种，例子有封面、目录、指标、趋势、对比、流程、风险、结尾。图表版式写了雷达、瀑布、矩形树图、漏斗、热力图、桑基、甘特；分析模型版式写了 SWOT、波特五力、PEST、商业模式画布、双钻。
steps.bodyEn: The README’s order is: state the topic, the audience, the page count, and the conclusions to highlight. The skill shows previews of the 12 themes and asks whether you need images or video; later you can ask the agent to restyle the whole deck. It then turns the request into structured content and a page plan. The README says each theme has its own page structures and visual language, across 20 page roles, with examples such as cover, table of contents, metrics, trends, comparison, flow, risks, and ending. Chart layouts named are radar, waterfall, treemap, funnel, heatmap, Sankey, and Gantt. Analysis layouts named are SWOT, Porter’s Five Forces, PEST, Business Model Canvas, and Double Diamond.

links.labelEn: How it works in the README

steps.title: 在浏览器里改这一页
steps.titleEn: Edit the page in the browser
steps.body: 生成之后，每一页有一块控制台。README 写可以拖滑杆增减模块数量、换布局、换图表类型，在一套风格里换局部配色；点击文字就地修改；点击或拖拽替换图片和视频槽，上传会自动压缩。只有文字的材料会自动留出图片占位。左侧缩略图可以拖着重排，页面可以跳过、删除或复制。顶栏可以进入放映、切换明暗、把改动全部重置。翻页动画 README 写有 9 种。改动自动保存。
steps.bodyEn: After generation, every page has a console. The README says you drag sliders to add or remove modules, switch layouts, and switch chart types, and you can change the local palette inside a theme. Click text to edit it in place. Click or drag to replace image and video slots; uploads are compressed automatically. Text-only source material reserves image placeholders. The thumbnail rail on the left reorders pages by drag, and a page can be skipped, deleted, or duplicated. The top bar enters presentation mode, switches light and dark, and resets every change. The README says there are 9 page transitions. Edits save automatically.

links.labelEn: Editing after generation in the README

steps.title: 导出可编辑的 PPTX
steps.titleEn: Export an editable PPTX
steps.body: README 写三种交付：HTML 离线包、PDF、可编辑 PPTX。命令行是 npm --prefix <project目录> run export:pptx -- <PPT输出目录>/ppt 输出.pptx，PDF 用同一前缀下的 export:pdf。导出 PPTX 和 PDF 需要本机 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge，路径可以用环境变量 CHROME_PATH 指定。也可以直接对 Agent 说用这个 skill 生成 PPT 格式的文件。FAQ 写：PPT 做不到 HTML 的全部能力，他们尽量把文字保持可编辑。本站没有安装这个 skill，也没有打开一份导出的 PPTX。
steps.bodyEn: The README names three deliverables: an offline HTML bundle, a PDF, and an editable PPTX. The command is npm --prefix <project-dir> run export:pptx -- <deck-output-dir>/ppt out.pptx, and PDF uses export:pdf under the same prefix. PPTX and PDF export need local Chrome, Chromium, or Edge; CHROME_PATH can point at the binary. You can also tell the agent to use this skill and produce a PPT file. The FAQ says PPT cannot carry everything HTML can, and that they keep text editable as far as they can. This site did not install the skill, and did not open an exported PPTX.

boundaries.text: 12 套主题、1020 个版式、8576 个可调控件，以及 20 种页面角色、9 种翻页动画、10 页大约 10 万 token，都是 README 里的数字。本站没有把版式库逐页数过，也没有跑一遍生成去对 token。推荐帖写「马上要破 9k star」。2026-09-26 用 gh api 读到的 stargazers_count 是 8794，这里只使用这个读数。

This site did not count the layout library page by page, and did not run a generation to check the token figure. The recommendation post says the repo is about to pass 9k stars. boundaries.text: PPTX 和网页版不是同一套能力。README 写 PPT 无法拥有 HTML 的全部能力，导出是尽量保留可编辑性，硬的部分会按节点做保真回退。同一套主题、不同版式，导出后文字还能不能直接改，本站没有逐个版式打开 PPTX 核对。导出失败时，README 让你先确认本机浏览器和 CHROME_PATH。
boundaries.textEn: The PPTX and the web deck are not the same set of capabilities. The README says PPT cannot carry everything HTML can, export keeps editability as far as it can, and hard regions use a per-node fidelity fallback. Whether text on a given theme and layout is still directly editable after export was not checked here by opening those PPTX files. If export fails, the README says to check the local browser and CHROME_PATH.

cases.summary: zero（@twoclipping）2026-09-25 的帖子公开了一份 UI 动效提示词模板：https://x.com/twoclipping/status/2103273003555402193 。2026-09-26 用 fxtwitter 核对，帖子创建于 2026-09-24 23:58 UTC（上海时区为 2026-09-25），视频附件为 14 秒、1440×1440。作者称整支片子由 Opus 5.5 写成代码，After Effects 用了 0。模板让同一个形状沿大约 120 BPM 的节拍走完一串界面状态，样式在 seek(t) 里按时间计算。本站未重跑生成。同日 Martijn Verbove（@verbove，做 MakerMap / doczen）用同一类做法讲自己的产品 MakerMap：https://x.com/verbove/status/2103483957266268381 。fxtwitter 附件为 20 秒、1440×1440。两条都是作者自述，本站未重跑。同日另有 Zsolt Kacso（@kaolti）的帖 https://x.com/kaolti/status/2103481296018092204 ：fxtwitter 核对创建于 2026-09-25 13:46 UTC，附件 39.5 秒、1920×1080。作者称在 HyperFrames 里给 Cosmos 做了这支片子，只用 2 条提示词、没有参考。提示词正文在他的回复串里，本站没有读到，不转写。

The fxtwitter attachment is 20 seconds at 1440×1440. Both posts stay the authors’ own claims; not re-run here. landing.whatEn: A prompt you hand to a model. The author, zero (display name, account @twoclipping), pasted it in the post. The aim is one HTML file and one shape on screen: it changes width, height, corner radius, and color, the content inside swaps with a short blur, and the camera pushes in so the current state fills the frame. The template is six blocks. inputs asks which states, which colors, and which track. direction sets the look and the bans. structure lays the states on the beat. build says how styles are computed from time, how the springs are written, and how the piece is rendered. gotchas are the traps he marks himself. start tells the model to lay the states on the beat grid before writing code. At the top of the post he says the piece is code, After Effects was not used, and the model is Opus 5.5. The fxtwitter attachment is a 14-second 1440×1440 video. This site did not run the prompt again on Opus 5.5.

contrast.caption: 左列只写模板 build 段里对得上的做法。右列说明它和另外三种常见做法差在哪一类问题上，不补充本库没核过的软件版本或菜单。
contrast.captionEn: The left column is only what the template’s build block actually specifies. The right column says which kind of problem separates it from three common approaches, without filling in software versions or menus this library has not checked.

rows.left: 每一帧的样式都在 seek(t) 里从时间算出来。模板写明不用 CSS transition，不用定时器，帧与帧之间不留状态。同一个 t 再算一次，结果应相同，所以可以按帧重渲。
rows.leftEn: Every frame’s styles are computed from time inside seek(t). The template says no CSS transitions, no timers, and no state carried between frames. The same t computed again should match, so a frame can be rendered again.
rows.right: 普通 CSS transition 是把起点和终点交给浏览器，中间帧由它的时钟去插。时长和缓动写在样式里，想精确对到某一拍，通常要改数字再看一遍，中间帧不在你的脚本里。
rows.rightEn: A plain CSS transition hands a start and an end to the browser, and its clock interpolates the frames in between. Duration and easing live in the stylesheet. Hitting a specific beat usually means changing a number and watching again; the in-between frames are not in your script.

rows.left: 节拍来自对音频的测量：模板写用 numpy 找出节拍网格，从强拍起，界面上的声音对齐测到的峰值。状态先铺在这个网格上，再写代码。某一拍不对，可以只重渲那一拍。
rows.leftEn: The beat comes from measuring the audio: the template says to use numpy to find the beat grid, start on a downbeat, and place UI sounds on the measured peaks. States are laid on that grid before any code. A beat that is off can be re-rendered on its own.
rows.right: After Effects 的常见做法是把关键帧放在时间轴上，对拍时回去拖关键帧或写表达式。对照点在于：这里的时间轴是节拍数据和 seek(t)，改完再跑渲染脚本，而不是在时间轴上拖点。本站没有打开作者的工程，帖子也称没有用 After Effects。
rows.rightEn: The usual After Effects path puts keyframes on a timeline and matches the beat by moving those keys or writing expressions. The comparison is that the timeline here is the beat data plus seek(t): change it, then run the render script again, rather than dragging keys. This site did not open an author project; the post itself says After Effects was not used.

rows.left: 交付物是一个 HTML，加上渲染脚本：Playwright 每帧再画 4 个子帧，ffmpeg 的 tmix 合成 60fps，用来做运动模糊。循环靠最后一帧和第一帧相同，包括光标的位置和速度。
rows.leftEn: The deliverable is one HTML file plus a render script: Playwright draws 4 subframes per frame, and ffmpeg’s tmix blends them to 60fps for motion blur. The loop depends on the last frame matching the first, cursor position and speed included.
rows.right: Lottie 交给播放器的是一份动画数据，播放器按时间去播。对照点在于：这份模板的画面是脚本按 t 一帧帧算出来的，循环条件写在模板的坑和收尾里，重渲就是再跑一遍 Playwright 和 ffmpeg。本站没有把作者的片子转成 Lottie 来比较文件。
rows.rightEn: Lottie hands a player a piece of animation data, and the player plays it against time. The comparison is that this template’s frames are computed by a script at each t, the loop condition is written into the template’s gotchas and ending, and re-rendering means running Playwright and ffmpeg again. This site did not convert the author’s piece to Lottie to compare files.

steps.title: 模板拆开：先问三样输入
steps.titleEn: Template, part one: it asks for three inputs
steps.body: inputs 段让模型先问你，而不是直接写代码。要的是 8 到 12 个界面状态，举例有按钮、加载、播放器、滑块、开关、标签、图表、命令面板、提示条；一套配色，纯黑白，或只加一个强调色；再加一首大约 120 BPM 的免版税曲子，文中举例 Mixkit。这一步还没有 HTML。
steps.bodyEn: The inputs block tells the model to ask you first, rather than writing code. It asks for 8 to 12 UI states — the examples are button, loader, player, slider, toggle, tabs, chart, command palette, toast — a color scheme of pure black and white or black and white plus one accent, and a royalty-free track around 120 BPM, with Mixkit named as the example. There is no HTML yet at this step.

steps.title: 模板拆开：一条形状，沿节拍走完
steps.titleEn: Template, part two: one shape, through the beat
steps.body: direction 段要求不切镜头。同一个元素改尺寸、圆角和颜色，内容切换带短模糊；光标用真实的点击和拖拽推动每次变化；底是浅暖灰，组件黑白，字体点名 Geist；弹簧只允许很小的过冲；镜头推近，让每一态充满画面；最后一帧等于第一帧，用来无缝循环。作者在这一段写了禁止项：弹跳缓动、粒子爆发、辉光、控件上的渐变、图标描边不统一、空拍，以及看起来像套模板的东西。structure 段写明 120 BPM、7 小节、每一拍都有事。状态顺序是：按钮，加载，勾选，Dynamic Island，播放器（播放和暂停互变），拖进度条，进度条变成音量滑块并在拉过最大值时被拉长，开关在拍点上翻转，旋钮变成液态标签指示条，标签展开成自己画出来的图表并在悬停时出提示，收成 Cmd+K，打字筛选，回车，提示条，再回到按钮。
steps.bodyEn: The direction block says not to cut. The same element changes size, radius, and color, and content swaps with a short blur. A cursor drives every change with real clicks and drags. The canvas is a light warm gray, the components are black and white, and the font named is Geist. Springs get only a tiny overshoot. The camera pushes in so each state fills the frame. The last frame equals the first, so it loops. In that same block he bans bouncy easing, particle bursts, glows, gradients on the UI chrome, mismatched icon strokes, dead time, and anything that looks like a template. The structure block specifies 120 BPM, 7 bars, and something on every beat. The order is: button, loader, check, Dynamic Island, a player whose play and pause morph, a scrub of the progress bar, the bar becoming a volume slider that stretches when dragged past the max, a toggle flipping on the beat, the knob becoming a liquid tab indicator, the tabs opening into a chart that draws itself with a tooltip on hover, collapsing into Cmd+K, typing to filter, Enter, a toast, and back to the button.

steps.title: 模板拆开：seek(t)、弹簧、节拍和出片
steps.titleEn: Template, part three: seek(t), springs, the beat, the render
steps.body: build 段一共七条。一个 HTML，画面 1440×1440。所有样式在 seek(t) 里按时间计算，没有 CSS transition，没有定时器，帧与帧之间不留状态。弹簧写成闭式的阶跃响应；一个值的目标改过好几次，就把每一次变化的弹簧加起来，结果仍然只取决于时间。标签指示条的两条边用不同的弹簧，前缘先被拉开，开关旋钮用同一手法。按住拖拽时，数值由光标位置算出；松开后从当时的位置弹回。用 numpy 分析曲子，找出节拍网格，从强拍开始，界面音效放到测到的峰值上。渲染用 Playwright：每帧 4 个子帧，再用 ffmpeg 的 tmix 混成 60fps 的运动模糊。正式出片前，先每一拍渲一帧，格子歪了、挤了或看不清就改。
steps.bodyEn: The build block has seven points. One HTML file, square, 1440×1440. Every style is computed from time inside seek(t): no CSS transitions, no timers, no state carried between frames. Springs are closed-form step responses. When a value changes target several times, you add one spring per change, and the result is still a function of time only. The tab indicator’s two edges ride different springs, so the leading edge stretches ahead of the trailing one; the toggle knob uses the same trick. While a drag is held, the value is computed from the cursor position; on release it springs back from wherever it was. numpy analyzes the song, finds the beat grid, and starts on a downbeat; UI sounds sit on the measured peaks. The render is Playwright at 4 subframes per frame, blended with ffmpeg’s tmix into 60fps motion blur. Before the full render, render one frame per beat and fix anything off the grid, cramped, or hard to read.

steps.title: 模板拆开：坑，以及动笔前的那一步
steps.titleEn: Template, part four: the gotchas, and the step before code
steps.body: gotchas 段写了三件具体的事。相机会缩放的东西不要加 will-change，否则文字发糊。变形容器里更换的文字要单独给进入和离开的时间，不然两段字叠在一起。最后一帧必须和第一帧相同，包括光标的位置和速度，否则循环会顿一下。start 段只有一句要求：先问输入，然后把状态列表铺在节拍网格上给作者看，之后才写代码。
steps.bodyEn: The gotchas block names three concrete things. Do not put will-change on anything the camera scales, or the text renders blurry. Text that swaps inside a morphing container needs its own enter and exit timing, or the two strings overlap. The last frame must match the first, cursor position and speed included, or the loop stutters. The start block has one requirement: ask for the inputs, then show the state list laid on the beat grid, and only then write code.

steps.title: 准备状态、配色和一首约 120 BPM 的曲子
steps.titleEn: Prepare the states, the colors, and a ~120 BPM track
steps.body: 自己试的时候按 inputs：先列出 8 到 12 个你想让这个形状变成的界面状态，定黑白或再加一个强调色，选一首大约 120 BPM 的曲子。模板举例 Mixkit，并写了 free for commercial use。这一句是作者的举例。商用前打开 Mixkit 上那一条音轨的许可，以站点当时的条款为准。字体若要跟模板一致，用 Geist。
steps.bodyEn: To try it, follow inputs: list 8 to 12 UI states you want the shape to become, pick black and white or black and white plus one accent, and choose a track around 120 BPM. The template names Mixkit and writes “free for commercial use.” That line is the author’s example. Before commercial use, open the license on that Mixkit track and follow the terms on the site at the time. For the font the template names, use Geist.

steps.title: 先让模型把状态铺到节拍上
steps.titleEn: Have the model lay the states on the beat first
steps.body: 把模板交给模型之后，停在 start。让它复述你的状态、配色和曲子，并把每一拍上是哪个状态列出来。网格对了，再让它写那个单文件 HTML，样式都放进 seek(t)。跳过这一步直接要成片，模板自己的顺序就被打乱了。
steps.bodyEn: After you hand over the template, stop at start. Have the model restate your states, colors, and track, and list which state sits on each beat. Once that grid looks right, have it write the single HTML file with every style inside seek(t). Asking for the finished piece before that skips the order the template sets.

steps.title: 用 Playwright 子帧和 ffmpeg tmix 出片
steps.titleEn: Render with Playwright subframes and ffmpeg tmix
steps.body: 模板的出片是：Playwright 打开那个 HTML，每一帧再采样 4 个子帧，ffmpeg 的 tmix 把它们合成 60fps。子帧是为了运动模糊。页面里没有 transition，也没有定时器，所以这不是在录一段 CSS 动画。正式渲之前，模板还要求先每一拍出一帧，检查是否出格、挤在一起或看不清。本站只渲了自己写的一帧示意（按钮收到加载），没有跑完这条出片管线，也没有重做作者的 14 秒片子。
steps.bodyEn: The template’s render is: Playwright opens that HTML, samples 4 subframes per frame, and ffmpeg’s tmix blends them to 60fps. The subframes are there for motion blur. The page has no transitions and no timers, so this is not a recording of a CSS animation. Before the full render, the template also asks for one frame per beat, to check anything off the grid, cramped, or hard to read. This site rendered one frame of its own (a button tightening into a loader) and did not run the full pipeline, or remake the author’s 14-second piece.

steps.title: 接触表先看一遍，再按画幅出片
steps.titleEn: Check a contact sheet first, then export each aspect ratio
steps.body: zero 的模板在正式出片前先每一拍渲一帧，再走 Playwright：每帧 4 个子帧，ffmpeg 的 tmix 合成 60fps。Verbove 把这一步写成接触表：先按拍把所有状态铺开，挤了就改，然后用无头 Chrome 以 60fps 渲，每帧平均 6 个子帧，ffmpeg 出 H.264、像素格式 yuv420p，1:1、16:9、9:16 并行导出。两条都是作者写在帖子里的步骤。本站没有跑完其中任何一条出片管线。
steps.bodyEn: zero’s template renders one frame per beat before the full piece, then Playwright at 4 subframes per frame, blended with ffmpeg’s tmix to 60fps. Verbove writes that pass as a contact sheet: lay every state out on the beat, fix anything cramped, then render in headless Chrome at 60fps, averaging 6 subframes per frame, and export with ffmpeg as H.264, pixel format yuv420p, with 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16 in parallel. Both are steps the authors wrote in their posts. This site did not run either full render pipeline.

boundaries.text: 成片取决于你用的模型和来回改的次数。direction 里禁止的效果，模型不一定一次就守住。will-change 和循环首尾这两条，模板写明是容易出错的地方。

sections.heading: 第二个例子：用它讲自己的产品
sections.headingEn: A second example: use it to explain your own product

paragraphs.text: 同一天，Martijn Verbove（显示名，账号 @verbove，做 MakerMap 和 doczen）发了另一条帖。他把一条已经在传的动效帖给 Opus 5.5 看，然后写了一句：explain MakerMap, but make it insane。作者称得到一支片子：一个形状沿产品走完注册、钉上一枚图钉、maker 把地球点亮、匹配、聚会、搜索。2026-09-26 用 fxtwitter 核对，帖子创建于 2026-09-25 13:57 UTC，附件元数据是 20 秒、1440×1440。帖子里写点亮地球的是 3,393 个 maker。这个人数是他写在帖子里的产品数据，本站没有登录 MakerMap，也没有核对。他用的函数名是 draw(t)；zero 的模板里对应的是 seek(t)。「整支由 Opus 5.5 写成、没用 After Effects」仍是作者自述，本站没有重跑，也没有从他的视频里截帧。
paragraphs.textEn: The same day, Martijn Verbove (display name, account @verbove, who builds MakerMap and doczen) posted another one. He showed Opus 5.5 one motion post that was already circulating, then wrote: explain MakerMap, but make it insane. He says the result is one shape moving through the product: sign up, drop a pin, makers lighting up a globe, matches, a meetup, search. Checked via fxtwitter on 26 Sept 2026: the post was created at 13:57 UTC on 25 Sept 2026, and the attachment metadata is 20 seconds at 1440×1440. The post says 3,393 makers light the globe. That count is product data he wrote in the post; this site did not sign in to MakerMap and did not check the number. His function name is draw(t); the matching function in zero’s template is seek(t). “Written by Opus 5.5, with no After Effects” stays his claim. Not re-run here, and no frame was taken from his video.

paragraphs.text: 他公开的骨架第一段是 inputs。先写产品和网址，再列 8 到 12 个界面状态，每个状态配上真实数据，然后是品牌色、字体和强调色，最后写需要的画幅：1:1、16:9、9:16。和 zero 的 inputs 相比，这里多了产品本身、每个状态上的真实数据，以及三种画幅一起交。
paragraphs.textEn: The first block of the skeleton he published is inputs. Name the product and its URL, list 8 to 12 UI states, put real data on each state, then brand colors, fonts, and the accent, and finally the formats required: 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16. Next to zero’s inputs, this one adds the product itself, real data on every state, and all three aspect ratios in one handoff.

paragraphs.text: rules 段规定一个 HTML 文件、一块画布、一个 draw(t)。不用 CSS transition，不用定时器，帧与帧之间不留状态。同一个形状从头走到尾，中间不切。一只光标推动整段：真实的点击、打字，外加一次拖拽。界面和数据都用真的，不用占位符。
paragraphs.textEn: The rules block specifies one HTML file, one canvas, and one draw(t). No CSS transitions, no timers, and no state carried between frames. One shape runs the whole way and is never cut. A cursor drives the sequence: real clicks, typing, and one drag. The UI and the data are real, with no placeholders.

paragraphs.text: structure 段把时间放在 120 BPM 的网格上，每一拍都有事。他写出的顺序是：logo，按钮，用户名输入，确认是不是你，加载，图钉，地球被用户点亮，匹配，标签，RSVP，搜索，再回到 logo。
paragraphs.textEn: The structure block puts time on a 120 BPM grid, with something on every beat. The order he wrote is: logo, button, a handle field, a confirmation that asks whether this is you, a loader, a pin, a globe filling with users, matches, tabs, an RSVP, search, and back to the logo.

paragraphs.text: motion 段用闭式弹簧，过冲很小。目标每改一次，就加一条弹簧，再把它们加在一起。内容要等容器开始变形之后才进来，并在下一次变形之前离开。切换时只给很短的模糊。不要从纯黑直接淡进强调色。标签指示条的两条边用不同的弹簧。镜头推近，让每一态铺满画面。最后一帧等于第一帧。
paragraphs.textEn: The motion block uses closed-form springs with a tiny overshoot. Each time a target changes, add one spring and sum them. Content enters after the container starts morphing and leaves before the next morph. Transitions get only a short blur. Do not fade straight from black into the accent. The tab indicator’s two edges ride different springs. The camera zooms so each state fills the frame. The last frame equals the first.

paragraphs.text: export 段先要求按拍出一张接触表，把挤在一起的状态改掉，再用无头 Chrome 以 60fps 渲，每帧平均 6 个子帧，ffmpeg 出 H.264、yuv420p，1:1、16:9、9:16 并行导出。和 zero 的出片差在哪，写在下面「怎么试」的最后一步。下面是转述后的骨架，不是帖子原文；原帖在 @verbove，前一条模板在 @twoclipping。
paragraphs.textEn: The export block first asks for one frame per beat as a contact sheet, and for cramped states to be fixed, then a headless Chrome render at 60fps that averages 6 subframes per frame, ffmpeg to H.264 yuv420p, and 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16 exported in parallel. How that differs from zero’s render is in the last step under How to try it. The skeleton above is a paraphrase, not the post verbatim. The original post is @verbove’s; the earlier template is @twoclipping’s.

sections.heading: 第三种路子：用现成框架
sections.headingEn: A third route: use a framework that already exists

paragraphs.text: Zsolt Kacso（显示名，账号 @kaolti，简介里写自己做设计和搭建）在 2026-09-25 13:46 UTC 发了 https://x.com/kaolti/status/2103481296018092204 。2026-09-26 用 fxtwitter 核对，附件元数据是 39.5 秒、1920×1080。正文说 Opus 5.5 大概是他近来看到的输出质量跳得最大的一次；他在 @HyperFrames_ 里给 Cosmos 做了这支片子，只用了 2 条提示词，完全没有参考；最后一句是 Prompts below。这些都是作者自己的说法。本站没有重跑，也没有从他的视频里截帧。「Cosmos」只按帖子里的词记下，没有另找一份产品页来定义它。
paragraphs.textEn: Zsolt Kacso (display name, account @kaolti; the bio says he designs and builds) posted https://x.com/kaolti/status/2103481296018092204 at 13:46 UTC on 25 Sept 2026. Checked via fxtwitter on 26 Sept 2026: the attachment metadata is 39.5 seconds at 1920×1080. He writes that Opus 5.5 is probably the biggest jump in output quality he has seen lately; that he built this in @HyperFrames_ for Cosmos with only 2 prompts and no references at all; and that the prompts are below. Those are his own claims. This site did not re-run it and did not take a frame from his video. “Cosmos” is recorded as the word in the post; no separate product page was opened to define it.

paragraphs.text: 提示词正文在他这条帖的自回复里。fxtwitter 的帖子接口只带回这一条，没有带回回复。xcancel 返回 451，试过的 nitter 镜像没有给出回复正文。这里不转写那两条提示词。要看原文，从上面的帖子点进回复串。
paragraphs.textEn: The prompt text is in his self-replies under that post. The fxtwitter status endpoint returned only this post, not the replies. xcancel returned 451, and the nitter mirrors that were tried did not return the reply text. Those two prompts are not paraphrased here. To read them, open the reply thread from the post above.

paragraphs.text: @HyperFrames_ 的简介写着 Write HTML. Render video. Built for Agents.，并写由 @HeyGen 开源。2026-09-26 打开 https://www.hyperframes.dev/ 返回 HTTP 200，文档页 https://hyperframes.heygen.com/introduction 也是 200。仓库 https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes 同日用 gh api 读到 license Apache-2.0、stargazers_count 53121、pushed_at 2026-09-26T06:36:07Z。README 把它写成开源框架：用 HTML、CSS、媒体和可以 seek 的动画，渲成确定性的 MP4。时间写在 data-start、data-duration 这类属性上，动画可以交给 GSAP 等，再登记成一条暂停的时间轴；渲染器在无头 Chrome 里按帧 seek，用 FFmpeg 编码。命令是 npx hyperframes init，然后 preview、render。README 写需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg，协议 Apache 2.0，没有按次渲染费。本站没有把 kaolti 的成片和仓库里的某一次提交对上。
paragraphs.textEn: The @HyperFrames_ bio says “Write HTML. Render video. Built for Agents.” and that it was open-sourced by @HeyGen. On 26 Sept 2026, https://www.hyperframes.dev/ returned HTTP 200, and the docs page https://hyperframes.heygen.com/introduction did too. The same day the gh api read https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes as license Apache-2.0, stargazers_count 53121, pushed_at 2026-09-26T06:36:07Z. The README describes an open-source framework: HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animation rendered to a deterministic MP4. Timing sits on attributes such as data-start and data-duration; animation can be a GSAP timeline registered while paused; the renderer seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes with FFmpeg. The commands are npx hyperframes init, then preview and render. The README says it needs Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg, the license is Apache 2.0, and there is no per-render fee. This site did not match kaolti’s finished video to a specific commit in that repo.

paragraphs.text: zero 和 Verbove 的路子是自己写一个 HTML：一个形状，一个随时间计算的函数（zero 写 seek(t)，Verbove 写 draw(t)），不用 CSS transition，出片脚本再去采样子帧。kaolti 用的是现成框架。画面仍然是 HTML，但轨道、时间属性和渲染命令由 HyperFrames 规定，作者说他只交了两条提示词、没有参考。两条都还是代码出片。差别在于时间函数和渲染器是模板里让模型现写，还是框架已经带好。本站没有打开他的工程。HyperFrames 是独立仓库，没有另开一条目录，只从这里链出去。
paragraphs.textEn: zero and Verbove’s route is to write one HTML file: one shape, one function of time (seek(t) in zero’s template, draw(t) in Verbove’s), no CSS transitions, and a render script that samples subframes. kaolti used a framework that already exists. The picture is still HTML, but the tracks, the timing attributes, and the render command are HyperFrames’. He says he handed over only two prompts and no references. Both routes are still code. The difference is whether the template asks the model to write the time function and the renderer, or the framework already ships them. This site did not open his project. HyperFrames stays a separate repo; it is linked from this page and is not a new catalog entry.

cases.title: 工具：美区 PayPal 绑国内 Visa — AI / Apple 订阅旁路
cases.titleEn: Tool tip: US PayPal with a China-issued Visa — AI / Apple subscription side path
cases.summary: 何居上（@hejushang8）2026-09-23 短帖：他的美区 PayPal 绑的是招商银行 Visa（截图尾号 2852），再挂到美区 Apple ID，用来付 App 订阅和线上购物。帖子引用同日长文《美区 PayPal 解决 99% 海外支付问题，注册及养号防封指南》。长文只讲个人账户付款：作者称可用于 AI 订阅、VPS、美区 Apple ID；收款和商业功能要 EIN / ITIN 等美国税务号，作者写明不涉及。准备项按作者清单：稳定美国节点（作者称机房 IP 也可以，在意的是登录地点别跳）、Visa 或万事达（中国发卡行也可以）、真实美国住宅账单地址、美国 +1 号（作者提到 Saily，约 1 美元）。顺序也是作者写的：paypal.com/us 开 Personal，+1 短信，姓名与卡一致，美国地址手动填（举例免税州俄勒冈），先跳过绑卡并验证邮箱，大约等一周再用同一美国节点确认正常，然后在 Wallet 绑国内 Visa / 万事达或 U 卡（作者举例 Bybit、P1、kast），账单地址用注册时那个美国地址。防封按作者经验：登录 IP 保持美国且稳定；没做 SSN / ITIN 就只当付款账户；可选 Wise 美国银行账户和验证器 2FA。本条是旁路工具笔记，完整步骤在作者长文。
cases.summaryEn: He Jushang (@hejushang8), 23 Sept 2026: his US PayPal is linked to a China Merchants Bank Visa (screenshot ending 2852) and then to a US Apple ID, for app subscriptions and online checkout. The post quotes his same-day article on registering a US PayPal and keeping it from being frozen. The article stays on a personal account used to pay: the author says it covers AI subscriptions, VPS, and a US Apple ID; receiving money and business features need a US tax ID such as an EIN or ITIN, which he leaves out. Prep, in his list: a stable US node (he says a datacenter IP was enough for him; what matters is not hopping countries), a Visa or Mastercard (a Chinese issuer is fine, he writes), a real US residential billing address, and a US +1 number (he mentions Saily at about $1). His order: open Personal at paypal.com/us, verify by +1 SMS, use a legal name that matches the card, add the US address manually (he cites tax-free Oregon), skip the card and verify email, wait about a week while signing in from the same US node, then bind a China-issued Visa / Mastercard or a U-card (he names Bybit, P1, kast) in Wallet, with the signup US address as billing. His anti-freeze notes: keep the login IP in the US and stable; without SSN / ITIN, treat the account as pay-only; optional Wise US bank account and authenticator 2FA. An adjacent tool note — the full steps are in his article.
cases.qualityNote: 作者自述。主源是 2026-09-23 短帖；2026-09-24（Asia/Shanghai）用 fxtwitter 镜像核对了正文和两张图：PayPal 钱包里招商银行 Visa 尾号 2852，以及美区 Apple ID 付款方式页。副源是同日长文（article 2102588711330590720）和引用帖 2102602033488634298。机房 IP、约一周再绑卡、Saily 约 1 美元、已用约 4 个月、能付 AI / VPS，都是作者自己的说法和截图。本站没有开设 PayPal 账户，也没有绑定任何银行卡。价格和优惠码与本条无关，不转载、不复核（Saily 另见 saily-us-number-esim）。有封号风险：作者写明账号可能被冻，卡若已经绑上且账号进不去，这张卡可能解不下来。完整步骤见作者长文。不构成购买建议，也不构成金融或法律建议；PayPal 官方页面优先。预览是作者短帖两张截图拼成 3:2。不打星。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Author self-report. Primary source is the 23 Sept 2026 post; on 24 Sept 2026 (Asia/Shanghai) the fxtwitter mirror was checked for the text and both images: a PayPal wallet with a China Merchants Bank Visa ending 2852, and a US Apple ID payment-method screen. Secondary sources are the same-day article (2102588711330590720) and quote post 2102602033488634298. Datacenter IP, waiting about a week before adding a card, Saily at about $1, roughly four months of use, and paying for AI / VPS are the author’s own claims and screenshots. This site did not open a PayPal account or bind any card. Prices and promo codes are unrelated to this entry and are neither copied nor re-checked (Saily is catalogued separately as saily-us-number-esim). Freeze risk: the author writes that the account can be locked, and a card already linked to an account he can no longer open may be stuck there. Full steps are in the author’s article. landing.whatEn: Errand is an open-source macOS desktop client under Apache-2.0 (repo LICENSE; the GitHub license API still reported Apache-2.0 on 2026-09-23). The site says it is powered by Runta Cloud Agents: each teammate has a conversation and a cloud computer with files and tools. Closing the local app does not delete teammates, conversations, or files — the app is a window onto the cloud workspace. Shiqi Mei’s 2026-09-22 write-up, and the title of HN item 49803044, frame it as an open-source take on Grok Bot / Muse. This library lists it on that basis: a reproducible adjacent stack, not an official Grok Bot or Muse replacement.

cases.qualityNote: 官方新角色，对象是通话教练而非外呼或客户跟进。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不把点评发给销售本人以外的人、不改 CRM、不联系客户；只返回带时间戳的教练笔记与分数。
cases.summaryEn: Official Sales Call Coach: reviews Gong calls and leaves timestamped coaching on discovery, objections, and executive presence, plus a call score—homework after every call. No CRM edits, no customer follow-up.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official role. Owns call coaching, not outbound or account follow-up.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not share coaching outside the seller, edit the CRM, or contact the customer; return timestamped notes and a score only.

cases.title: 交易台协调：先拟内部 deal note，批准后再写入 Salesforce
cases.summary: 官方 Deal Desk Coordinator：从历史邮件、Salesforce 和通话起草带上下文的内部交易说明，你批准后再提交进 Salesforce。改价、条款与对外承诺必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方明确「先拟、批准后再写入 Salesforce」。现有管道记分板不覆盖交易台纸面。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不提交 Salesforce、不改价格或条款、不对外承诺；只返回内部 deal note 草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Deal Desk Coordinator: drafts contextual internal deal notes from past emails, Salesforce, and calls, then submits in Salesforce once you approve. Pricing, terms, and external commitments stay behind approval.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official copy is explicit: draft first, write to Salesforce after approval. The Monday scoreboard does not cover deal-desk paper.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not submit to Salesforce, change price or terms, or commit externally; return the internal deal-note draft only.

cases.title: 续约台：带着 90 天包走进每场续约
cases.summary: 官方 Renewal Desk Operator：按客户从用量、工单、Gong、CRM 拼 90 天续约包，起草商务说明，只有条款卡住才去催法务。不联系客户、不改合同。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把续约台从客户健康观察名单里拆出来：产出是 90 天商务包，不是风险榜。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改合同或报价、不催法务以外的人；只返回续约包与待审商务说明。
cases.summaryEn: Official Renewal Desk Operator: builds a 90-day pack per account from usage, tickets, Gong, and CRM, drafts the commercial note, and nudges legal only when terms are stuck. No customer contact, no contract edits.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits renewal desk from account-health watch: the output is a 90-day commercial pack, not a risk list.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact the customer, change contracts or quotes, or ping anyone but legal when stuck; return the pack and draft commercial note only.

cases.title: 幻灯片现场更新：发现纪要从会中写进下一页
cases.summary: 官方 Deck Updater：根据发现纪要在会中或会后立刻改 Deck，并把下一步写进幻灯片，让你离开房间时页面已经在动。不对外发 Deck、不改主模板品牌。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Sales 新角色。现有内容案例是广告视频/建站，没有会中改 Deck。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不把 Deck 发给客户、不改主模板；只更新本次会议用的副本并标出改动。
cases.summaryEn: Official Deck Updater: updates your deck from discovery notes mid-call or right after, with next steps baked in, so you leave the room with the slide already moving. Does not send the deck or change the master brand system.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Sales role. Existing content cases are ad video / site build, not mid-call deck updates.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the deck to the customer or change the master template; update this meeting’s copy and mark the diffs.

cases.title: Beta 采用观察：看谁真的在用新功能
cases.summary: 官方 Product 角色 Beta Adoption Watcher：盯用量，标出哪些客户已经进来试用新功能，方便团队跟进。不联系客户、不改功能开关。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。客户健康是流失/扩张，这里是「新功能谁在用」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改功能开关或实验分组；只返回采用名单与证据链接。
cases.summaryEn: Official Product role Beta Adoption Watcher: monitors usage and surfaces which customers are actually in on the new feature so the team can follow up. No customer contact, no flag flips.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Account Health is churn/expansion; this is “who is actually using the new feature.”
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact customers or change flags/experiments; return the adoption list and evidence links only.

cases.title: 通话 FAQ 挖掘：用真实通话养活赋能文档
cases.summary: 官方 Call FAQ Miner：从真实通话里追踪问题、给回答打时间戳，并链回源录音，让赋能材料跟着通话更新。不改对外帮助中心、不把摘录当最终话术发布。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有会议笔记落任务不覆盖「从通话挖 FAQ + 时间戳回链」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发布到帮助中心或对外话术库；只返回带时间戳与源录音链接的 FAQ 草案。
cases.summaryEn: Official Call FAQ Miner: keeps enablement current from real calls—tracks questions, timestamps answers, and links back to the source recording. Does not publish to the help center or treat excerpts as final scripts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Meeting-notes→tasks does not cover mining FAQs with timestamped source recordings.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not publish to the help center or external scripts; return a FAQ draft with timestamps and source links only.

cases.title: 文档审计：对照上周发版抓过期页
cases.summary: 官方 Docs Auditor：把帮助中心和内部说明对照上周已发版功能做 diff，标出过期页并起草改写。不直接改线上文档。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有产品性能调查不覆盖文档过期审计。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不直接改线上帮助中心或对外文档；只返回过期页清单与改写草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Docs Auditor: diffs the help center and internal notes against what shipped last week, flags stale pages, and drafts the rewrite. Does not edit live docs.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Product-performance investigation does not cover stale-docs audit.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit the live help center or public docs; return the stale-page list and rewrite drafts only.

cases.title: 需求溯源：永远不丢「谁提的这功能」
cases.summary: 官方 Feature Request Tracker：从 Slack 和通话里挖需求，做成绑到具体客户的活清单，让规格书有真实需求轨迹。不建票、不承诺排期。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有客服退款/工单分拣不覆盖「需求溯源到客户」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不新建工单、不承诺排期、不回复客户；只返回绑到客户的需求清单与出处。
cases.summaryEn: Official Feature Request Tracker: mines Slack and calls into a living list tied to customers, so the spec has a real demand trail. Does not file tickets or promise a schedule.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Support refunds / ticket triage do not cover a customer-tied demand trail.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not file tickets, promise a schedule, or reply to customers; return a customer-tied request list with sources only.

cases.title: 产品反馈分析：把散落信号收成优先视图
cases.summary: 官方 Product Feedback Analyst：从已连接来源收集并聚类反馈，权衡证据与紧急度，起草路由建议等人批准。不改路线图、不回用户。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把反馈聚类/路由从需求溯源、性能调查里拆出来。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改路线图、不回复用户、不建工单；只返回聚类、证据与待批路由建议。
cases.summaryEn: Official Product Feedback Analyst: collects and clusters feedback from connected sources, weighs evidence and urgency, and drafts routing recommendations for approval. No roadmap edits, no user replies.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits clustered feedback routing from request tracking and performance investigation.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change the roadmap, reply to users, or file tickets; return clusters, evidence, and routing drafts only.

cases.title: 玩法测试操作员：API 不够时硬开 UI
cases.summary: 官方 Playtest Operator：当 API 不够用时，在电脑上硬走产品路径、捕获失败，并交回一份紧凑发现包。与 Bug 复现不同——这是主动压路径，不是跟一张报修走。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有 bug-repro / Slack 复现是跟报修走；这里是主动玩法压测。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产、不碰真实客户数据、不提 PR；只返回步骤、截图与发现包。
cases.summaryEn: Official Playtest Operator: brute-force tests the product path on a computer when APIs are not enough, captures failures, and returns a tight findings pack. Distinct from bug reproduction: this is proactive path-pressing, not following one ticket.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Existing bug-repro follows a report; this proactively playtests a path.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production, touch real customer data, or open a PR; return steps, screenshots, and a findings pack only.

cases.title: 原型构建：从一句话到可点的 URL
cases.summary: 官方 Prototype Builder：在自己的电脑上写，尽快从需求变成可点的东西，回来时带截图和线上 URL。不买域名、不接生产流量。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有建站 Bot 是买域名部署上线；这里停在可点原型。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不买域名、不绑生产、不公开推广；只返回原型 URL、截图与已知限制。
cases.summaryEn: Official Prototype Builder: writes on its computer and goes from ask to something clickable fast, coming back with a screenshot plus a live URL. Does not buy a domain or attach production traffic.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Website Builder buys a domain and ships live; this stops at a clickable prototype.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not buy a domain, attach production, or promote publicly; return the prototype URL, screenshots, and known limits.

cases.title: 云端 Agent 编排：盯一堆 run，卡住再催
cases.summary: 官方 Cloud Agent Orchestrator：同时拉起多个 cloud agent run，监控进度、追卡住的任务，并汇总报告，避免你逐个盯。不改生产、不扩大权限。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有 Cursor Automations 是相邻产品；这里是 Grok Bot 自己编排 cloud agent run。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产配置、不扩大权限、不合并无人审的结果；只拉起 run、追卡住的、交汇总。
cases.summaryEn: Official Cloud Agent Orchestrator: kicks off many cloud-agent runs, monitors them, chases what is stuck, and summarizes the report so you are not babysitting each one. No production changes, no permission expansion.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Cursor Automations is adjacent; this is Grok Bot owning a fleet of cloud-agent runs.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production, expand permissions, or merge unreviewed results; start runs, chase stuck ones, and return the summary.

cases.title: 安全问卷填写：门户里先填满，提交留给你
cases.summary: 官方 Security Questionnaire Filler：登录供应商安全问卷站，从你们的 trust center 和历史 RFP 抽答案，填好每个字段，提交按钮留给你。不臆造合规结论。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Ops 新角色，计算机使用典型场景：没干净 API 的门户代填。现有 29 条没有安全问卷。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不点击提交、不签署、不发明没有出处的答案；缺证据就标「待补」。
cases.summaryEn: Official Security Questionnaire Filler: logs into the vendor questionnaire site, pulls answers from your trust center and past RFPs, drafts every field, and parks submit for you. Does not invent compliance answers.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Ops role and a canonical computer-use job: portals with no clean API. None of the existing 29 cover security questionnaires.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not submit or sign, and do not invent unsourced answers; mark gaps as needs-input.

cases.title: 供应商门户代劳：每周走同一条无 API 路径
cases.summary: 官方 Vendor Portal Operator：在没有干净 API 的门户上跑续约、席位和采购，每周点同一条路径，只把例外带回来。下单、改席位、付款必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Ops 新角色。办公室经理是工单/排班门户；这里是供应商续约与采购门户。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不下单、不改席位、不付款；只返回本周例外与待批操作清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Vendor Portal Operator: runs renewals, seats, and procurement on portals with no clean API, clicks the same path every week, and comes back with exceptions only. Orders, seat changes, and payments need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Ops role. Office Manager is work-order portals; this is vendor renewal and procurement portals.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not place orders, change seats, or pay; return this week’s exceptions and a pending-action list.

cases.title: 合同台：一周纸面按阶段和负责人一览
cases.summary: 官方 Contract Desk：按阶段和负责人汇总本周合同，抽出关键条款，标出卡住的评审。不改条款、不代表签字。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Finance 新角色。现有发票管道/费用管家不覆盖合同阶段与条款抽取。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改条款、不签字、不对外发合同；只返回阶段表、关键条款与阻塞清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Contract Desk: summarizes the week of paper by stage and owner, pulls key terms, and flags blocked reviews. No term edits, no signing.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Finance role. Invoice pipeline and expense manager do not cover contract stages or term extraction.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit terms, sign, or send contracts; return the stage table, key terms, and blockers only.

cases.title: 退款追回经理：找到索赔、提交并跟到底
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖「Refunds manager」：找到索赔、提交并跟进，带着追回的退款或折扣回来。这是你作为消费者/采购方去追钱，不是客服给用户办政策内退款。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」新角色。已有 support-in-policy-refunds 是客服给用户退款；这里方向相反：替你追索赔。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不提交索赔、不接受和解、不改支付方式；只返回可追索清单、草稿材料与跟进状态。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion-post Refunds manager: finds the claim, files it, and follows it through, coming back with the refund or discount it recovered. This is you claiming money back—not in-policy customer refunds.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role. Existing support-in-policy-refunds issues refunds to customers; this files claims on your behalf.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not file a claim, accept a settlement, or change payment methods; return the recoverable list, draft packets, and follow-up status.

cases.title: SEO / AEO 审计：关键词、技术和 AI 提示一起盯
cases.summary: 官方 SEO / AEO Auditor：把关键词、技术、AI 提示和对手动向收在一处，告诉你在涨还是在丢，标出该修的站点问题，并给出可执行优化计划。不直接改线上页面。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有竞争情报蜂群是模拟公司，不是站点 SEO/AEO 审计。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改线上页面、不发内容、不买外链；只返回审计与优化计划。
cases.summaryEn: Official SEO / AEO Auditor: tracks keyword, technical, AI-prompt, and competitor movement in one place, surfaces whether you are gaining or losing ground, flags site issues, and returns an optimization plan. Does not edit live pages.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Competitive-intel swarm is a company simulation, not a site SEO/AEO audit.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit live pages, publish, or buy links; return the audit and the plan only.

cases.title: 社媒经理：按你的声音起草，排队等人点发布
cases.summary: 官方 Social Media Manager：研究你的真实历史发文，有值得说的上线就起草，把帖子停在待发布队列并保持队列流动。不自行发布、不互动。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有一人公司/newsletter 栈不是独立的社媒排队 Bot。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发布、不点赞、不回复；只返回草稿与建议发布时间。
cases.summaryEn: Official Social Media Manager: studies your real history, drafts when something noteworthy ships, parks posts for you to publish, and keeps the queue moving. Does not publish or engage on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. The one-person newsletter stack is not a dedicated social queue Bot.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not publish, like, or reply; return drafts and a suggested post window only.

cases.title: 付费素材策略：在赢家变明显之前写下假设
cases.summary: 官方 Paid Media Creative Strategist：尽早抓住创意赢家，写清「为什么有效」的假设，并提出下一轮测试。官方强调不编造指标。与付费预算监控不同。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把素材策略从付费预算监控里拆出来。现有 paid-media-monitor 只做花费/CAC 再分配。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改广告、不改预算、不发明指标；只返回假设、证据与下一测建议。
cases.summaryEn: Official Paid Media Creative Strategist: spots early creative winners, writes a sharp why-it-works hypothesis, and proposes the next test. Official rule: no invented metrics. Distinct from paid-media budget monitoring.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits creative strategy from budget monitoring. Existing paid-media-monitor only reallocates spend/CAC.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change ads or budgets, and do not invent metrics; return the hypothesis, evidence, and next-test plan.

cases.title: LinkedIn 投放经理：广告、表单、跟进和 UTM 对齐
cases.summary: 官方 LinkedIn Campaign Manager：把获客漏斗在广告、表单、跟进和 UTM 上对齐，先起草活动等人批准，并保持每个 offer 与交接干净。不自行开投。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有 Paid Media 是跨渠道预算；这里专管 LinkedIn 漏斗一致性。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不启用广告、不改预算、不对外发跟进；只返回活动草稿、UTM 与交接清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official LinkedIn Campaign Manager: owns lead-gen funnel consistency across ads, forms, follow-up, and UTMs. Drafts campaigns for approval and keeps every offer and handoff clean. Does not launch spend on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Paid Media is cross-channel budget; this owns LinkedIn funnel consistency.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not enable ads, change budgets, or send follow-up; return campaign drafts, UTMs, and the handoff list.

cases.title: 营销日历负责人：区域/全球内容与活动对齐
cases.summary: 官方 Marketing Calendar Owner：让区域和全球的内容、上线与活动日历保持同步，从 Notion 拉取，并让 webinar 与战役不用每周人工追。不对外发公告。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有一人公司栈有 newsletter，没有区域/全球营销日历主人。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发对外公告、不改已发布档期；只返回冲突、缺口与待批日历更新。
cases.summaryEn: Official Marketing Calendar Owner: keeps regional and global content, launch, and events calendars in sync, pulls from Notion, and keeps webinars and campaigns current without a weekly chase. Does not send public announcements.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. The one-person stack has a newsletter, not a regional/global marketing-calendar owner.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send public announcements or change published dates; return conflicts, gaps, and pending calendar updates.

cases.title: 周边履约：兑换表审批后才给供应商下日单
cases.summary: 官方 Merch Fulfillment Operator：对合适的潜客做周边触达，盯兑换表，在聊天里让你批准/拒绝提交，再给供应商发每日订单，告诉他们何时何地发货。发货与对外消息必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色，审批点写进文案（chat 里批准/拒绝）。现有 29 条没有周边履约。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不批准兑换、不向供应商下单、不对外发周边；只返回待批提交与每日订单草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Merch Fulfillment Operator: runs outreach, watches the redemption form, pings you in chat to approve/reject submissions, and sends the swag vendor a daily order form so they know when and where to dispatch. Shipping and outbound messages need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role with the approval gate written in (approve/reject in chat). None of the 29 cover merch fulfillment.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not approve redemptions, place vendor orders, or ship merch; return pending submissions and a daily order-form draft.

cases.title: 社区运营经理：大使申请、私信分拣与节奏培育
cases.summary: 官方 Community Operations Manager：筛大使申请、跨渠道分拣私信，并按节奏起草培育内容，让社区不再是全职追人。不自行通过申请、不私发官方承诺。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有客服退款/收件箱分拣不覆盖大使循环。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不通过/拒绝申请、不对外发私信；只返回筛选结果、分拣队列与培育草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Community Operations Manager: screens apps, triages DMs across channels, and drafts nurture on a cadence so community is not a full-time chase. Does not approve applicants or send official promises on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Support refunds and inbox triage do not cover an ambassador loop.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not accept or reject applicants, and do not send DMs; return the screen, triage queue, and nurture drafts.

cases.title: 关键事件监测：有真实由头才建议互动
cases.summary: 官方 Compelling Events Monitor：盯管理层动态里的获奖、发布与招聘信号，交出一份可互动帖子短摘要，并按你的声音起草评论或引用转发。不自行发帖。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有付费监控/竞争情报不覆盖「领导层由头→待互动摘要」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发帖、不评论、不引用转发；只返回由头摘要与待审互动草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Compelling Events Monitor: watches leadership posts for awards, launches, and hiring signals, then sends a short digest of posts to engage with, plus comments or quote-reposts in your voice. Does not post on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Paid-media monitor and competitive intel do not cover a leadership-trigger engagement digest.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not post, comment, or quote-repost; return the trigger digest and draft engagements only.

cases.title: 活动嘉宾筛选：按 ICP 打分，批量待批入邀请工具
cases.summary: 官方 Event Guest Screener：按 ICP 给活动申请打分，并把强匹配批量放进邀请工具等人批。不擅自发邀请。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。招聘筛选吃的是职位申请；这里吃的是活动报名。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送邀请、不批量通过；只返回 ICP 打分与待批名单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Event Guest Screener: scores event applicants against your ICP and batch-approves strong fits in the invite tool. Does not send invites on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Hiring Screener scores job applications; this scores event applicants.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send invites or batch-approve; return ICP scores and a pending list only.

cases.title: 赋能交付：把「把录音发我」变成链接回复
cases.summary: 官方 Enablement Fulfillment Specialist：找到 Zoom 资产、做一页纸、上传到 Drive，并起草带链接的回复，避免有人再说「把录音发我」时去翻箱。不自行外发。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 CS 新角色。现有会议笔记落任务不覆盖「找 Zoom→一页纸→Drive→待发回复」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发邮件、不把录音发到未经批准的对象；只返回资产链接与待发回复。
cases.summaryEn: Official Enablement Fulfillment Specialist: finds Zoom assets, builds one-pagers, uploads to Drive, and drafts the reply with links so “send me the recordings” does not mean digging. Does not send the reply on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official CS role. Meeting-notes→tasks does not cover Zoom→one-pager→Drive→draft reply.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send email or share recordings with unapproved recipients; return asset links and a draft reply.

cases.title: 工单分拣专员：盯队列，只起草回复
cases.summary: 官方 Ticket Triage Specialist：按节奏看支持队列，只起草回复，队列干净时保持安静。与政策内退款 Bot 不同：这里不碰退款，也不关单。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 CS 新角色。已有 support-in-policy-refunds 处理退款；这里是队列分拣+仅草稿。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送回复、不关单、不退款；只返回分拣与草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Ticket Triage Specialist: watches support on a cadence, drafts replies only, and stays quiet when it is clean. Distinct from in-policy refunds: no refunds, no closing tickets.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official CS role. Existing support-in-policy-refunds handles refunds; this is queue triage with draft-only replies.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send replies, close tickets, or issue refunds; return triage and drafts only.

cases.title: 演示文稿设计师：从主模板做出可编辑链接
cases.summary: 官方 Presentation Designer：用你的主模板和品牌体系做 Deck，不从空白页开始，并交出可继续改的编辑链接。不对外发送、不改品牌主文件。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 General 新角色。Deck Updater 是会中改已有页；这里是按主模板新建。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发 Deck、不改品牌主文件；只返回可编辑链接。
cases.summaryEn: Official Presentation Designer: builds on-brand decks from your master template and brand system—not a blank slide—and delivers an editable link ready to refine and present. Does not send externally or change the brand master.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official General role. Deck Updater edits an existing deck mid-call; this builds a new one from the master.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the deck externally or change the brand master; return an editable link only.

cases.title: 对内传播经理：按对象和渠道起草，只审不发
cases.summary: 官方 Internal Communications Manager：从真实上下文起草清晰、合你声音的对内文案，并匹配对象与渠道。官方写明 review-only，绝不自行发送。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色，审批边界写进角色名（review-only）。现有幕僚长是摘要，不是对内文案起草。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送任何对内或对外消息；只返回分受众、分渠道的草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Internal Communications Manager: drafts clear, on-voice copy from your real context, matched to each audience and channel. Officially review-only—it never sends on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role with review-only in the copy. Chief of Staff is a digest, not internal comms drafting.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send any internal or external message; return audience- and channel-matched drafts only.

cases.title: 隔夜销售外呼管道
cases.summary: Sales Outbound Bot 隔夜研究 CRM 客户、按 ICP/意向打分、找联系人，并用销售本人语气起草邮件与 LinkedIn 内容，只留下待审收件箱。官方要求：未批准前不发送、不入组。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 canonical 流程，带 starter prompt 与清晰审批边界。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送、不入组；停在待审列表
cases.summaryEn: Sales Outbound Bot researches CRM accounts overnight, scores them by ICP/intent, finds contacts, and drafts email and LinkedIn copy in the seller’s voice — leaving only a review inbox. Official rule: do not send or add to sequences until approved.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official canonical flow, with a starter prompt and a clear approval boundary.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send or add to sequences; stop at the review list

cases.title: 演示环境就绪检查清单
cases.summary: Demo Bot 隔夜拉起环境，检查产品 UI/演示数据，修复坏种子与过期数据，在客户通话前交出「演示就绪」清单。
cases.qualityNote: 结果二元清晰：demo-ready，适合销售+工程协作故事。
cases.summaryEn: Demo Bot stands up the environment overnight, checks product UI/demo data, fixes bad seeds and stale data, and hands over a “demo-ready” checklist before the customer call.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Binary, clear outcome: demo-ready. A good sales + engineering collaboration story.

cases.title: CRM 管道周一记分板
cases.summary: Bot 维护 CRM 与组织架构卫生，标记停滞与承诺风险，并在周一发布记分板，让团队一开始就对齐。
cases.qualityNote: 典型周期性运营 digest 模式。
cases.summaryEn: The Bot keeps CRM and org hygiene, flags stalled deals and commitment risk, and posts a Monday scoreboard so the team starts aligned.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A typical recurring ops-digest pattern.

cases.title: 客户跟进与温度运营
cases.summary: 根据通话纪要更新 CRM 备注、起草产品更新、开支持工单、在团队现有工具里同步下一步——工作落在真实系统里，而不只在聊天中。
cases.qualityNote: 强调「结果落到人用的系统」的内部实践案例。
cases.summaryEn: Updates CRM notes from call recaps, drafts product updates, opens support tickets, and syncs next steps in the tools the team already uses — work lands in real systems, not only in chat.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An internal practice case that stresses “results land in the systems people use.”

cases.title: 人才侦察（招聘寻源）
cases.summary: 负责寻源、候选人研究、外联草稿与日程准备。示例：找 20 名符合硬性条件的候选人、排除 ATS 重复、引用证据、起草个性化外联——不主动联系。
cases.qualityNote: 官方角色，含隐私/合规提示，适合「只起草外联」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系候选人
cases.summaryEn: Owns sourcing, candidate research, outreach drafts, and calendar prep. Example: find 20 candidates who meet hard criteria, drop ATS duplicates, cite evidence, and draft personalized outreach — do not contact anyone.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official role with privacy/compliance notes. Fits “draft outreach only.”
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact candidates

cases.title: 付费投放监控与预算建议（仅推荐）
cases.summary: 拉取各活动花费与表现，对照月度预算与目标 CAC，给出带数字的再分配建议，并起草给增长团队的 Slack 更新——不改预算、不发送。
cases.qualityNote: 清晰的分析→推荐→审批闭环。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改预算、不发送
cases.summaryEn: Pulls spend and performance by campaign, compares them to the monthly budget and target CAC, writes a numbered reallocation recommendation, and drafts a Slack update for growth — does not change budgets or send.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A clear analyze → recommend → approve loop.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change budgets or send

cases.title: 每周费用管家
cases.summary: 从费用系统+政策汇总周报，匹配财务收件箱收据，标记缺失分类与政策例外并引用出处，为每位负责人起草一封跟进——只返回摘要与草稿。
cases.qualityNote: 高重复性财务杂务，文档强调与源数据对账。
cases.summaryEn: Builds a weekly report from the expense system + policy, matches receipts in the finance inbox, flags missing categories and policy exceptions with sources, and drafts one follow-up per owner — returns only the summary and drafts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: High-repetition finance chores; the docs stress reconciling against source data.

cases.title: 产品性能调查包
cases.summary: 例如调查昨日发布后的结账延迟：查仪表盘/链路/火焰图，返回带截图与链接的短报告，区分事实与假设，不改生产、不改告警。
cases.qualityNote: 证据优先的工程调查模式。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产/告警
cases.summaryEn: Example: investigate checkout latency after yesterday’s release. Check dashboards/traces/flame graphs and return a short report with screenshots and links, separating facts from guesses. Do not change production or alerts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An evidence-first engineering investigation pattern.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production/alerts

cases.title: 预发环境 Bug 复现包
cases.summary: 阅读缺陷报告，在预发用全新测试账号复现，返回精确步骤、期望/实际、截图、浏览器/OS、控制台与网络笔记、最小用例。示例触发：Slack #customer-escalations +「needs repro」。
cases.qualityNote: 最佳官方事件触发工程工作流。
cases.summaryEn: Reads the bug report, reproduces it on staging with a fresh test account, and returns exact steps, expected/actual, screenshots, browser/OS, console and network notes, and a minimal case. Example trigger: Slack #customer-escalations + “needs repro.”
cases.qualityNoteEn: The best official event-triggered engineering workflow.

cases.title: 客户健康 / 流失风险观察名单
cases.summary: 按用量、支持升级、续约时点、干系人活跃度给组合账户打分；给出证据、为何重要、建议下一步——不联系客户、不改 CRM。可升为工作日 8:00 skill+routine。
cases.qualityNote: 文档旗舰「skill → routine」示例。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改 CRM
cases.summaryEn: Scores a portfolio of accounts by usage, support escalations, renewal timing, and stakeholder activity; returns evidence, why it matters, and a suggested next step — does not contact customers or edit CRM. Can be promoted to a weekday 8:00 skill+routine.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The docs’ flagship “skill → routine” example.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact customers or edit CRM

cases.title: 幕僚长晨间摘要
cases.summary: 对照优先级文档，回顾昨日至今的 Slack/邮件/日历/会议笔记；只返回匹配项，并附来源、为何重要、建议下一步、以及你是否欠一个决策——不发送、不改会议。
cases.qualityNote: 最常被引用的「第一个 Bot」角色。
cases.summaryEn: Against a priority doc, reviews Slack/email/calendar/meeting notes since yesterday; returns only matches, with source, why it matters, a suggested next step, and whether you owe a decision — does not send or change meetings.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The most-cited “first Bot” role.

cases.title: 收件箱分拣 → ClickUp 交接
cases.summary: 定时 Inbox Triage Bot 抓取 Gmail（+日历）、标记紧急项，把结构化简报交给幕僚长，由其在 ClickUp 创建带截止日期与优先级的任务——团队看看板而不是只看聊天。
cases.qualityNote: 社区强演示：两个窄 Agent + 现有 PM 工具作系统真源。
cases.summaryEn: A scheduled Inbox Triage Bot pulls Gmail (+ calendar), flags urgent items, and hands a structured brief to the chief of staff, who creates dated, prioritized ClickUp tasks — the team looks at a board, not only chat.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A strong community demo: two narrow Agents + an existing PM tool as system of record.

cases.title: 发票 Agent + 收件箱交接管道
cases.summary: 上传参考发票 PDF；Invoice Agent 起草同类发票、带附件的 Gmail 回复草稿，并在 ClickUp「Invoices and Payments」看板跟踪状态。可与 Inbox Triage 群聊交接，让发票邮件自动路由。
cases.qualityNote: 端到端 SMB 运营闭环；生产环境发送需审批。
cases.summaryEn: Upload a reference invoice PDF. Invoice Agent drafts a matching invoice, a Gmail reply draft with attachment, and tracks status on the ClickUp “Invoices and Payments” board. Can hand off in a group chat with Inbox Triage so invoice mail routes automatically.
cases.qualityNoteEn: End-to-end SMB ops loop; sending in production still needs approval.

cases.title: 会议笔记 → 带截止日任务（Granola @ 17:00）
cases.summary: 每天 17:00 例行抓取 Granola 笔记，提取行动项，按规则路由到正确的 ClickUp 看板（如代理 vs YouTube），并填负责人、优先级与截止日期。
cases.qualityNote: 高杠杆「会议债务」杀手。
cases.summaryEn: A 17:00 daily routine pulls Granola notes, extracts action items, routes them to the right ClickUp board (e.g. agency vs YouTube) by rule, and fills owner, priority, and due date.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A high-leverage “meeting debt” killer.

cases.title: 手机拍照生成产品广告视频
cases.titleEn: Product Ad Video from Phone Photo
cases.summary: Video Agent + Higgsfield 插件 + 已保存的产品广告 skill：在 iOS 拍产品照，提示「生成产品广告」，几分钟得到成片；skill 可用 / 引用。
cases.qualityNote: 创作者侧的 teach/skill 具体模式。
cases.summaryEn: Video Agent + Higgsfield plugin + a saved product-ad skill: shoot the product on iOS, prompt “generate a product ad,” and get a finished cut in minutes. The skill can be invoked with /.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A concrete creator-side teach/skill pattern.

cases.title: 竞争情报 / 公司模拟蜂群
cases.summary: 多个角色 Bot（研究、核实、策略、工程、营销）通过群聊共享上下文；可用 Composio 接多应用。示例：并行负责人对比编码 Agent 评测，或竞品定价/功能蜂群 → 高管简报。
cases.qualityNote: 写得最好的多 Agent 架构指南，含 token 与共享电脑安全提醒。
cases.summaryEn: Several role Bots (research, verify, strategy, engineering, marketing) share context in a group chat; Composio can connect multiple apps. Example: parallel owners comparing coding-agent evals, or a competitor pricing/feature swarm → exec brief.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The best-written multi-agent architecture guide, including token and shared-computer safety notes.

cases.title: 一人公司 / Newsletter 运营栈
cases.summary: 幕僚长审计业务并命名首批 Agent（研究、销售、平台专家）；一项目一账户控制上下文/token；例行把 newsletter、目录、Shopify 等工作挪到夜间。
cases.qualityNote: 可执行的创始人运营模型：审计 → 招聘 Agent → 周报。
cases.summaryEn: Chief of staff audits the business and names the first Agents (research, sales, platform specialist); one account per project to control context/tokens; routines move newsletter, directory, and Shopify work into the night.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An executable founder ops model: audit → hire Agents → weekly report.

cases.title: 网站上线多 Bot 小组
cases.summary: 文档模式：Website Launch 群组含上线协调、内容编辑、分析审阅；协调员分派，交接在同一对话可见。社区也有 EA 用自然语言把建站交给工程 Bot。
cases.qualityNote: 清晰的「项目舱」协作 IA。
cases.summaryEn: Docs pattern: a Website Launch group with launch coordination, content editing, and analytics review; the coordinator assigns work, and handoffs stay visible in the same thread. Community examples also have an EA handing site-building to an engineering Bot in natural language.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A clear “project pod” collaboration IA.

cases.title: Slack 触发的复现 / 升级例行
cases.summary: 窄事件规则：当 #customer-escalations 出现工单链接 +「needs repro」时，Bot 打开工单、在预发复现、在对话中贴复现包——未经批准不回帖到 Slack。避免「每条新消息」监听。
cases.qualityNote: 事件触发设计金标准：窄匹配、审批、失败策略。
cases.summaryEn: A narrow event rule: when #customer-escalations has a ticket link + “needs repro,” the Bot opens the ticket, reproduces on staging, and posts the repro pack in the thread — does not reply in Slack without approval. Avoid listening to “every new message.”
cases.qualityNoteEn: Gold standard for event-trigger design: narrow match, approval, failure policy.

cases.title: Cursor Automations：工程工厂模式（相邻）
cases.summary: 同生态的 Cursor 云端 Agent：main 推送安全审查→Slack；PR agentic codeowners；PagerDuty→Datadog 调查→Slack+修复 PR；周仓 digest；晨间覆盖率 PR；Slack 缺陷分拣→Linear→尝试修复。
cases.qualityNote: 非 Grok Bot UI，但同属 Cursor 生态「常开 Agent」模式，适合 Coding/DevOps 筛选。
cases.summaryEn: Same-ecosystem Cursor cloud Agents: main-push security review→Slack; PR agentic codeowners; PagerDuty→Datadog investigation→Slack+fix PR; weekly repo digest; morning coverage PR; Slack bug triage→Linear→attempted fix.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Not the Grok Bot UI, but the same Cursor-ecosystem “always-on Agent” pattern. Useful when filtering for Coding/DevOps.

cases.title: 演示教学：把浏览器流程存成 Skill
cases.titleEn: Teach a Task: Demo a Browser Workflow into a Skill
cases.summary: 官方 Skills / Routines 文档给出的可执行模式：在一对一对话打开电脑视图，选 Teach a task，演示最多约 10 分钟的浏览器流程，Bot 生成草稿 Skill。补上决策规则、失败处理和审批边界后再用 Test run，最后才做成例行。不录音频，演示中不要暴露密钥，凭证走安全交接。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「先一次性任务 → Skill → Routine」闭环，和现有业务角色案例互补，可直接照文档操作。
cases.approvalBoundary: 写操作与外发保持审批；演示时不暴露密钥
cases.summaryEn: The executable pattern from the official Skills / Routines docs: open computer view in a 1:1, choose Teach a task, demo a browser flow of about 10 minutes max, and the Bot drafts a Skill. Add decision rules, failure handling, and approval bounds, then Test run, and only then turn it into a routine. No audio recording; do not expose secrets during the demo; hand credentials over securely.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The official “one-off task → Skill → Routine” loop. Complements the business-role cases and can be followed from the docs.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Keep writes and outbound behind approval; do not expose secrets during the demo

cases.title: 把几十条访谈视频收成一条可看的成片
cases.titleEn: Research, transcribe, and cut a science video brief
cases.summary: KanekoaTheGreat 用自然语言让 Grok Bot 找出 Dr. Roger Seheult 谈阳光、红光、红外与线粒体的全部相关视频（含 MedCram，以及与 Huberman、Eric Berg、Steven Bartlett 等的访谈）。几分钟后交出：38 条视频转写合成一份 Word、精选 13 段科学讲解并剪成 19:35 成片、以及带原片时间戳的 Markdown 摘要。无脚本、无代码。
cases.qualityNote: 社区真人工作流：非程序员用一句话把「搜片—转写—精选—剪辑—摘要」一次做完。适合作为研究/内容 Bot 的示范，外发成片前仍建议人审。
cases.approvalBoundary: 成片与对外发布前需人审；注明素材来源与时间戳，不把转写当最终引用。
cases.summaryEn: KanekoaTheGreat asked Grok Bot in natural language to find every Dr. Roger Seheult video on sunlight, red light, infrared, and mitochondria (including MedCram and talks with Huberman, Eric Berg, Steven Bartlett, and others). Minutes later it returned: a Word file of 38 video transcripts, 13 science segments cut into a 19:35 film, and a Markdown brief with source timestamps. No script, no code.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A real community workflow: a non-programmer finished “find–transcribe–select–edit–summarize” in one sentence. A good research/content Bot demo; still review before publishing the cut.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Human review before the cut goes public; cite sources and timestamps, and do not treat transcripts as final quotes.

cases.title: 数字断舍离：邮箱、网盘与订阅审计
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖里的 Digital declutterer：全天候审计邮箱、Drive 和付费订阅，整理出可取消清单（金额、最近使用）。只有你点头才丢弃或退订。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」新角色，审批边界非常清晰：只审计、列清单，退订必须人审。适合作为第一个生活向 Routine。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不丢弃文件、不退订、不删除账号；只返回审计清单。
cases.summaryEn: Digital declutterer from the official expansion post: around-the-clock audit of email, Drive, and paid subscriptions, producing a cancel list (amount, last used). It discards or unsubscribes only after you nod.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A new official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role. The approval bound is very clear: audit and list only; canceling needs a human. A good first life-admin Routine.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not discard files, unsubscribe, or delete accounts; return only the audit list.

cases.title: 会议替身：缺席时入会并带回摘要
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Meeting stand-in：你去不了时由 Bot 入会、向房间说明你在场、做详细笔记并发送摘要，让你事后仍跟得上。
cases.qualityNote: 和「会议笔记 → 任务」不同：这是真人缺席时的入会替身。日历/会议权限敏感，摘要外发需审批。
cases.approvalBoundary: 入会与对外发摘要前需人审；不代为做承诺或改日程。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Meeting stand-in: when you cannot go, the Bot joins, tells the room you are represented, takes detailed notes, and sends a summary so you can still catch up.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Different from “meeting notes → tasks”: this is a stand-in when a person is absent. Calendar/meeting permissions are sensitive; sending the summary needs approval.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Joining and sending the summary need human review; do not make commitments or change the calendar.

cases.title: 建站 Bot：做站、买域名、部署上线

cases.approvalBoundary: 不覆盖正式美术目录、不提交到发行分支、不对外发布；只交草稿资产与清单。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not overwrite the production art tree, commit to a release branch, or publish; hand over draft assets and a list only.

cases.title: 办公室经理：工单、排班与门户代劳
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Office manager：接收工单、规划产能，并在 Gmail、Slack、ServiceTitan、Quo 和客户门户之间代为点选。让店主不必同时活在六个工具里。预约、改价、对外消息默认停在审批。

Booking, price changes, and outbound messages stop for approval by default.

cases.qualityNoteEn: An official multi-portal operator role, distinct from inbox triage: it owns work orders and capacity, not mail filing. High-consequence actions (booking, changing appointments) need a human.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不确认预约、不改价、不向客户发送消息；只整理工单队列与建议排班。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not confirm bookings, change prices, or message customers; return a work-order queue and a suggested schedule only.

cases.title: 客服退款 Bot：政策内退款先拟后批

cases.qualityNoteEn: Official role plus a real community run: in-policy refunds are money, so draft first and wait for a nod. Distinct from inbox triage because it talks to the payments API.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发起退款、不改支付方式、不自动回复顾客；先提交订单号、金额、政策对照与待批草稿。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not issue a refund, change the payment method, or auto-reply to the customer; first return order id, amount, policy check, and a draft for approval.

cases.title: 边推婴儿车边用语音买菜

Afterwards the Bot compared named-brand prices at other delivery supermarkets. She split this off the chief of staff into a dedicated Shopping Bot so shopping would not fill the context window.
cases.qualityNote: 社区真人教程，不是官网一句话角色：移动端语音、截图核对、人过验证码、付款必须人审。适合当生活向 Routine 的示范。

cases.title: Mobile MCP：让 AI 直接点 iOS / Android App
cases.titleEn: Mobile MCP: let the agent tap iOS / Android apps over MCP
cases.summary: Mobile Next 开源的 MCP 服务器（Apache-2.0），把 iOS / Android 模拟器、仿真器与 USB 真机接给任何支持 MCP 的客户端：Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot、Cursor 等。优先读无障碍树拿结构化元素，读不到再退回截图点坐标。工具覆盖列设备、装卸 / 启停 App、点滑输入、按键、深链、录屏、抓 logcat 与崩溃报告。标准配置 `npx -y @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest`，默认 stdio，`--listen` 可起 SSE 并用 MOBILEMCP_AUTH 加 Bearer。
cases.summaryEn: Mobile Next’s open-source MCP server (Apache-2.0) that exposes iOS / Android simulators, emulators, and USB-connected real devices to any MCP client — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and more. Reads the accessibility tree first for structured elements, falls back to screenshot + coordinates. Tools cover device listing, app install/launch/terminate, tap/swipe/type, hardware buttons, deep links, screen recording, logcat and crash reports. Standard config is `npx -y @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest`; stdio by default, `--listen` for SSE with a MOBILEMCP_AUTH Bearer token.
cases.qualityNote: 由 @Ryrenz 2026-09-08 中文帖带来，主源是 GitHub README。当日核对：6468 star / 562 fork，最新版 1.0.3（帖内写 6353 star，已按实数）。需本机 Xcode 命令行工具或 Android Platform Tools，Node 20+。README 明写默认向 PostHog 发匿名遥测，MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 可关。mobilewright（Playwright 式移动测试）与 mobilecli（底层设备 CLI）在 README 核到，作次链接；Mobile Next Cloud 云真机是付费服务，本库未试。README 示例提示词里的注册、评分、发消息都会在真设备上真做。非 xAI / Grok Bot 官方件，能否接进 Grok Bot 以当日官方 MCP 文档为准。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Surfaced by @Ryrenz’s Chinese post on 2026-09-08; the primary source is the GitHub README. Checked that day: 6,468 stars / 562 forks, latest release 1.0.3 (the post said 6,353; we use the live count). Needs local Xcode CLT or Android Platform Tools and Node 20+. The README states anonymous PostHog telemetry is on by default; MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 turns it off. mobilewright (Playwright-style mobile tests) and mobilecli (the device CLI underneath) are verified in the README and linked as secondary; Mobile Next Cloud is a paid device service we did not try. The README’s sample prompts really register, rate, and message on the device. Not an xAI / Grok Bot first-party piece — whether it plugs into Grok Bot depends on the official MCP docs that day.
cases.approvalBoundary: 只在自己的模拟器 / 测试机与测试账号上跑；装卸 App、注册、发消息、评分评论、开非常规 URL scheme（MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS，默认禁）前人审。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Run only on your own simulators / test devices with test accounts; human sign-off before installing or removing apps, registering, messaging, rating or commenting, or enabling non-standard URL schemes (MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS, blocked by default).

cases.title: 6yuwei：共享云电脑、审批门与六种可测工作流
cases.titleEn: 6yuwei: shared cloud computer, approval gates, and six testable workflows
cases.summary: 2026-08-28 长文：把 Grok Bot 与 Grok 聊天 / Grok Build / API 拆开讲，再落到四根架构柱（共享云电脑、Computer Use、演示学任务/Routine、人审门），并给出可谨慎试跑的六种模式——幕僚长多 Agent、意向线索、缺陷复现开 Issue、无 API 遗留系统 RPA、品牌竞品值守、夜间批处理。强调窄角色、先读后写、Bot 不是安全边界。
cases.summaryEn: Aug 28, 2026 guide: separates Grok Bot from Grok chat / Grok Build / API, then covers four pillars (shared cloud computer, computer use, teach/routines, approval gates) and six carefully testable patterns—chief-of-staff multi-agent, intent lead prep, bug reproduction tickets, legacy RPA without APIs, brand/competitor watch, and nightly batch jobs. Stresses narrow roles, read-and-prepare first, and that Bots are not security boundaries.
cases.qualityNote: 社区架构解读（2026-08-28）。六种工作流是模式清单，作者写明需自测连接器与审批；文内「早期 beta / 能力因套餐而异」以原文为准，本库不当 KPI。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Community architecture write-up (2026-08-28). The six workflows are patterns to test carefully; connector access and approvals vary. Early-beta caveats are the author’s—do not treat as KPIs.
cases.approvalBoundary: 外发邮件、CRM 写库、生产改动、购买与删改保持人审；先只读草稿再放开写权限。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Keep outbound email, CRM writes, production changes, purchases, and deletes human-gated; start read-only drafts before granting write access.

cases.title: Cursor 文档：安装桌面端到第一次审阅
cases.titleEn: Cursor docs: install desktop through first review
cases.summary: Cursor 官方 Get started：从仪表盘下载桌面端、用 Cursor 账号登录、创建专注 Bot（示例 Piper：产品性能调查、证据与假设分开、不改生产设置）、给边界清晰的首任务、在 Agent Computer 上手动登录工具、审阅后沉淀为 skill/routine；并说明 iOS 同云电脑可消息/接管/审批，但 Teach a task 与改 Routine 仍在桌面。
cases.summaryEn: Official Cursor Get started: download the desktop app from the dashboard, sign in with Cursor, create a focused Bot (example Piper: product-performance investigation, evidence vs hypotheses, never change production), hand a bounded first task, take over Agent Computer for tool logins, then review and save a skill/routine. Notes iOS shares the same cloud computer for messaging/takeover/approvals, while Teach a task and routine editing stay on desktop.
